name: support-tool-stack
description: Customer support platform selection, setup, and optimization — Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Help Scout, HubSpot Service Hub, Linear, and AI-native tools. Use when choosing a support platform, migrating tools, setting up help desk workflows, designing ticket routing, building macros and saved replies, or integrating support with CRM and product. Covers head-to-head comparison, pricing by stage, and implementation playbooks.
